name: complete
description: Required only when the session plan binds this turn (created or updated this turn, or a resume / goal-mode turn); without a binding plan the call is optional. When it applies, call once with a short summary after the last tool action, once every plan step is done or skipped. The runtime reopens the turn if plan steps remain pending, running, or failed. A plan carried from an earlier turn binds only after this turn updates it. Any later tool action, including `plan` or `plan_update`, invalidates the assertion, so call `complete` last.

summary.description: What was accomplished (one or two sentences).
